messages.content: Hi, I just received the MacBook and unfortunately the screen is cracked. This definitely wasn't mentioned in the listing.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can assure you it was in perfect condition when I shipped it - I have photos from packing. Can you send me pictures of the damage and the packaging?
I've uploaded photos as evidence. The box had a dent in it when it arrived. I think it was damaged in shipping.
I see. That dent looks like rough handling by FedEx. I'd recommend filing a shipping damage claim. I can provide my packing photos as evidence it was in good condition when shipped.
